card.name: Digits and stray symbols in numbers
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a digit like 0 or 4 inside a number (e.g. "≥ 10 mL"). It also responds to broken, unreadable symbol bytes in tables of numbers, and to "p" in a page citation.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a quantity, often before mL or nmol/L.
modes.example: flush the intravenous catheter used exclusively for PLUVICTO administration with ≥ 1<<0>> mL of 0.9% Sodium

modes.label: Broken symbol in tables
modes.description: An unreadable replacement character between values in dose or dosimetry tables.

modes.label: Page abbreviation
modes.description: The letter p in a reference page citation.

card.writes: It promotes spacing and odd symbol characters and suppresses ordinary word pieces, so it favors a space or symbol next.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of numbers and on garbled symbols between figures in tables.
